newsitem.title: UK: London stocks claw back losses on New York rally.
newsitem.headline: London stocks claw back losses on New York rally.

text.p: The UK's FTSE closed slightly lower but at the day's best level on Thursday, clawing back hefty initial losses after U.S. stocks surged on tame inflation data.

Bank stocks led the gainers, helped by more talk of share buybacks and continued positive analyst comment. But recent strength in sterling dogged the chemicals sector which slumped on earnings downgrades.
The FTSE finished 0.5 points lower at 4,087.0 with losers and gainers roughly evenly matched. The Mid-250 closed 14.6 points lower at 4,517.7. Volume totalled 679 million at the 1630 GMT close.
